## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.8
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.106.8

2 PRs. 1 fixed, 1 changed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Cost tracking and pricing:** Fixed incorrect transcription cost for some FLAC files, which could push a key over its budget (#50842) <sup>Also in [1.108.5](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.5)</sup>
- **Cost tracking and pricing:** Changed per-second transcriptions to bill the `usage.seconds` the provider reports instead of the measured length (#50727) <sup>Also in [1.108.5](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.5)</sup>

---

Backport #50861 · [Full changelog](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.106.7...v1.106.8)

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.1
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.110.0-rc.1/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.1
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---
## What's Changed
* fix(completion): accept a tool_choice that forces an OpenAI hosted tool by @kerry-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50578
* fix(accounting): stop delivery metrics from scanning retained receipts on every flush by @joshua-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50565
* fix(key/info): return 400 instead of 500 when no key is provided by @apex-mochen in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/43577
* fix(gemini): add the Flex above-200k cache read price to gemini-3.1-pro-preview rows by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50607
* test(observability): match the full card number instead of a 4111 substring that timestamps can contain by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50612
* fix(proxy): align ownership and scope handling by @mateo-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50600
* feat(proxy): total_timeout bounds a whole non-streaming request by @joshua-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50496
* fix(cli): end the local login when lite logout cannot check the OS keychain by @zoveki in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50098
* fix(ui): label every budget reset time in the Admin UI with UTC by @zoveki in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50591
* fix(proxy)!: price expanded wildcard /model/info rows as the model their calls route to by @paveln83 in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/49128
* fix(bedrock): derive the web identity session policy per AWS caller by @tavren27 in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50592
* perf(router): skip unused deployment reads in the callback filter step and cache anthropic capability probes by @narmstrong-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50641
* test: update stale integration expectations and backport the Together e2e repin (#50601) by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50756
* test(integration): drop the empty-string n case from the Gemini long decode test by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50794
* test: update the spend tests that still expected the pre-ledger accounting queues by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50805
* fix(router): backport the mid-stream request fallback fix (#50260) to rc/1.110.0 by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50798
* test: repair four integration tests on rc/1.110.0 by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50855
* fix(redis): backport the per-request Redis batch scope leak fix (#50751) to rc/1.110.0 by @narmstrong-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50949
* fix(router): backport the registry lock fix (#50933) to rc/1.110.0 by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50993

## New Contributors
* @apex-mochen made their first contribution in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/43577

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.110.0-dev.2...v1.110.0-rc.1

## Verify this release ```bash cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0 ``` Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images ## What's new in 1.109.0 982 PRs. 144 added, 424 fixed, 60 changed, 17 improved, 9 removed. 5 need action ### Action required - **Routing and fallbacks:** Change string fallback targets to lists of model names (#48943) - **Caching:** Switch `cache_params.type` from `disk` to `local` or `redis`, since the `disk` cache backend (diskcache) has been removed (#48114) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Add `optional_pre_call_checks: ["enforce_model_rate_limits"]` to keep a hard `rpm` cap on deployments (#48873) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Set `drop_params: true` or stop sending `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` to Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and newer (#47645) - **Deployment:** Deploy Lens from its own chart and set `lens.*` in your values (#49169) ### Highlights - **Admin UI:** Added a Chat UI with a model hub, image generation and usage metrics (#48108) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Added mid-stream fallback continuation so a streaming chat cut off mid-answer continues on the configured fallback (#41127) - **Deployment:** Added `LITELLM_OFFLINE_MODE` to turn off every fetch LiteLLM makes on its own with one switch (#48096) - **Cost tracking and pricing:** Added `model_info.pricing_provider` to price a deployment from another provider's catalog rates instead of $0 (#47620) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Added Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS support, including multi-speaker voices and `mp3`, `opus`, `alaw` and `mulaw` output (#31915) - **SDK:** Fixed tool calls on `completion()` and `responses()` failing with `No module named 'mcp'` on base SDK installs (#45961) Also in [1.108.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.4) ### All changes
OpenAI (19) - Added per-deployment workload identity on non-chat routes, realtime and the moderation guardrail (#39966) - Added the 12-hour cache write rate for `gpt-5.6-cyber` (#48246) - Added OpenAI `gpt-6.1-terra` with pricing (#48429) - Added Batch and Ultrafast 12-hour cache write rates for OpenAI models (#48433) - Added `gpt-6-rosalind` to the model cost map with its published prices (#49268) - Added `gpt-6-astra-law` with pricing from the OpenAI pricing page (#49444) - Fixed 400 errors and $0 spend logs on `gpt-transcribe` calls without `response_format` (#44021) - Fixed nonstreaming `aiohttp_openai` responses dropping `service_tier` (#47263) - Fixed `prompt_cache_retention` such as `24h` being silently dropped instead of sent upstream (#47480) - Fixed `/health` marking OpenAI and Azure audio chat models unhealthy (#47730) - Fixed OpenAI `context_length_exceeded` errors raising `BadRequestError` instead of `ContextWindowExceededError` (#47954) - Fixed 12-hour prompt cache writes on `openai/gpt-5.6` and newer billing at the 30-minute rate (#48088) - Fixed uncatalogued ChatGPT models hitting an unsupported Chat Completions endpoint (#48244) - Fixed the whole `reasoning_effort` dict not being sent when chat is bridged to Responses (#48807) - Fixed 400 `invalid_beta` on Agents API calls through the OpenAI passthrough (#49009) - Fixed empty `e.response.text` on OpenAI and Azure errors so the upstream error body is readable (#49079) - Changed OpenAI 401 and 404 `invalid_request_error` to raise matching exceptions, not `BadRequestError` (#32537) - Changed the ChatGPT session id to derive from `prompt_cache_key` for stable cache affinity (#42014) - Changed `gpt-6-luna` Decisions cache rates to the standard cached and write rates (#48066)
Azure (18) - Added Entra ID auth, including keyless auth, for Azure Decisions on `/v1/decisions` and `/v1/systemone` (#46539, #48529) - Added access to Foundry agents through the project Responses API for `azure_ai/agents/` (#47717) - Added `azure_ai/MAI-Code-1.1-Flash` (#47779) - Added `max_input_tokens` of 32768 for `azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1` (#48434) - Added `outputContentFormat=markdown` support on `/ocr` for Azure Document Intelligence (#48926) - Fixed Foundry chat requests losing OpenAI prompt cache breakpoints (#45299) - Fixed `/v1/responses` 404 on dated `api_version` deployments and `azure_ai` Grok reasoning token billing (#46377) - Fixed under-billed Grok reasoning tokens on `azure_ai` when the deployment name lacks "grok" (#46969) - Fixed Azure realtime over WebRTC failing with a 404 on `client_secrets` and an invalid token on the SDP exchange (#47316) - Fixed 400 from Foundry when tool results contain `tool_reference` parts on chat (#48032) - Fixed 400 on `azure_ai/claude-*` when using `thinking.block_binding` (#48033) - Fixed Responses API calls that use an explicit v1 Azure base URL (#48118) - Fixed 404 on Azure vector store retrieve, update and delete (#48224) - Fixed null audio capability metadata on two Azure audio snapshot models (#48475) - Fixed Azure `context_length_exceeded` raising `BadRequestError` so `context_window_fallbacks` never ran (#48616) - Fixed batch calls on unversioned `azure/` o3, o4-mini, o3-mini, gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini billing at the standard rate (#49182) - Changed `max_input_tokens` to 128000 for `gpt-chat-latest` on Azure (#48252) - Improved Entra auth by reusing credentials and tokens across requests and refreshing them off the event loop (#46421, #47348, #48769)

> [!TIP]
> The `lts` image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull `ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts` to stay on the newest LTS patch

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.1
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.108.1/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.1
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---
## What's Changed
* ci: run the OSV scan and unit tests on stable, rc and lts branches (#50086) [backport lts/1.108.x] by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50088
* test: fix stale unit tests on 1.108 LTS by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50091
* fix(backport): backport 21 main fixes plus 2 prerequisites to lts/1.108.x for v1.108.1 by @kerry-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50136
* fix(passthrough): skip team deployments when picking proxy-wide pass-through credentials on lts/1.108.x by @kerry-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/50217


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.108.0...v1.108.1

## Verify this release

This release candidate is built from [`f9778e9`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/f9778e945daf481495272d68283d51bd72002f7c), the reviewed merge of #50129 into `rc/1.107.0`. It is published as `1.107.0rc3` on PyPI and `v1.107.0-rc.3` on Docker


Some users are still running the 1.107 release candidates and needed two GitHub Copilot fixes for per-user credentials. This release brings those fixes to that line. releases.body:
## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.7
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.106.7

We are readjusting how beta features work alongside LiteLLM, our core product. Starting with 1.106.7, the Lens beta is no longer packaged with the proxy or its Helm charts. If you use Lens today, v1.106.6 keeps working as it does now

2 PRs. 1 added, 1 changed. 1 needs action

### Action required

- **Lens:** If your Helm values set `lensWorker.enabled`, remove it before upgrading so the chart renders (#49173)

### Changes

- **Embeddings, images and audio:** Added `/v1/videos` support for custom providers registered in `custom_provider_map` (#49802)

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0-rc.1
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.109.0-rc.1/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0-rc.1
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

releases.body:
## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0-dev.2
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.109.0-dev.2/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0-dev.2
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

releases.body:
## Verify this release ```bash cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0-dev.1 ``` Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images ## What's new in 1.109.0-dev.1 704 PRs. 113 added, 312 fixed, 46 changed, 11 improved, 8 removed. 15 need action ### Action required - **Deployment:** Update image verification to use the new `cosign.pub` key (#48103) - **Chat completions:** Guard `chunk.choices[0]` reads with `if chunk.choices:` when `include_usage` is set (#47109) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Set `drop_params: true` or stop sending `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` to Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and newer (#47645) - **Cost tracking and pricing:** Read `max_input_tokens` and `max_output_tokens` instead of `max_tokens` from the cost map (#48471) - **Anthropic:** Set `max_tokens` on requests to unmapped Anthropic models, or set `DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS` to 4096 (#48502) - **AWS Bedrock:** Set `streaming_buffer_until_moderated: true` on the guardrail if `converse-stream` replies still need masking (#46307) - **Logging and observability:** Set the GCS bucket and service account in proxy config instead of per request (#48599) - **Token counting:** Set a provider key on deployments used with count endpoints, since a local estimate is no longer returned (#46815) - **Keys, teams and auth:** Make `budget_duration` and `budget_id` changes on keys as an admin, since owners and team members now get 403 (#47681) - **Keys, teams and auth:** If `personal_key_model_access_from_teams` is on, grant needed MCP servers and agents to owners' teams first (#46293) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Add the `tag_routing_prefix` to caller routing tags, or move them to the key or team (#47428) - **Chat completions:** Handle 408 `litellm.Timeout` and `request_timeout` where you matched 500 `APIConnectionError` or `server_error` (#47198) - **Deployment:** Set `image_tag` or all four `*_image` URIs when sourcing the Terraform module from a git ref (#46960) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Raise a low `tpm` on Gemini TTS deployments, since limits now count TTS tokens (#44551) - **AWS Bedrock:** Increase budgets for keys or teams that run a traced `guardrailConfig` on every Bedrock call (#48278) ### Highlights - **Admin UI:** Added a Chat UI with a model hub, image generation and usage metrics (#48108) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Added mid-stream fallback continuation so a streaming chat cut off mid-answer continues on the configured fallback (#41127) - **SDK:** Fixed tool calls on `completion()` and `responses()` failing with `No module named 'mcp'` on base SDK installs, broken since v1.106.0 (#45961) - **Other providers:** Added OpenInfer as an OpenAI-compatible provider with `openinfer/` calls and spend tracking (#41034) - **Other providers:** Added xAI X Search to the Search API and WebSearch interception, with citation URLs and cost tracking (#48677) - **Deployment:** Added `LITELLM_OFFLINE_MODE` to turn off every fetch LiteLLM makes on its own with one switch (#48096) - **Cost tracking and pricing:** Added `model_info.pricing_provider` to price a deployment from another provider's catalog rates instead of $0 (#47620) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Added Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS support, including multi-speaker voices and `mp3`, `opus`, `alaw` and `mulaw` output (#31915) - **Agents:** Added `agent_access_default_deny` to stop keys with no agent grants from reaching every agent (#43979) ### More changes by area
OpenAI (10) - Added per-deployment workload identity on non-chat routes, realtime and the moderation guardrail (#39966) - Added OpenAI `gpt-6.1-terra` with pricing (#48429) - Fixed `prompt_cache_retention` such as `24h` being silently dropped instead of sent upstream (#47480) - Fixed 12-hour prompt cache writes on `openai/gpt-5.6` and newer billing at the 30-minute rate (#48088) - Plus 6 smaller fixes and updates (#43935, #44021, #46967, #47954, #48066, #48246)
Azure (18) - Fixed `/v1/responses` 404 on dated `api_version` deployments and `azure_ai` Grok reasoning token billing (#46377) - Fixed Azure realtime over WebRTC failing with a 404 on `client_secrets` and an invalid token on the SDP exchange (#47316) - Improved Entra auth by reusing credentials across requests and refreshing tokens off the event loop (#47348) - Plus 15 smaller fixes and updates (#43955, #46421, #46539, #46969, #47292, #47567, #47779, #48032, #48033, #48118, #48224, #48252, #48434, #48475, #48529)
Anthropic (10) - Fixed a fake `[System: ...]` message being added to tool-call-only assistant turns sent to Anthropic (#34822) - Fixed Claude `json_schema` answers losing keys listed only in `required` and escaping non-ASCII characters, broken since v1.107.0-rc.1 (#47478) - Fixed replayed `redacted_thinking` blocks being dropped, and Bedrock Converse 400s when sent twice (#47489) - Fixed streamed responses leaving native web search fees out of the reconstructed usage cost (#48528) - Plus 6 smaller fixes and updates (#41397, #46102, #46741, #47394, #47987, #48633)

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.0-rc.1
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.108.0-rc.1/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.0-rc.1
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---
## What's Changed
* fix: bring rc/1.108.0 to parity with the v1.106.x patch fixes by @yuneng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/48691


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.107.0-rc.1...v1.108.0-rc.1

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). Every release is signed with the same key introduced in [commit `0112e53`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.2
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.106.2/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.2
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

* fix(count_tokens): backport Bedrock Mantle 404 fallback to stable/1.106.x by @mateo-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/47742

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). Every release is signed with the same key introduced in [commit `0112e53`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.0
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.106.0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.0
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). Every release is signed with the same key introduced in [commit `0112e53`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.103.5
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.103.5/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.103.5
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---
## What's Changed
* fix(responses): backport #46099 and #46109 to stable/1.103.x for v1.103.5 by @mrinal-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/46949


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.103.4...v1.103.5

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). Every release is signed with the same key introduced in [commit `0112e53`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.107.0-dev.2
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.107.0-dev.2/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.107.0-dev.2
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). Every release is signed with the same key introduced in [commit `0112e53`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.0-rc.4
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.106.0-rc.4/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.0-rc.4
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---

* feat(decisions): backport #45474, #45811, #45734, #46594, and #46596 to rc/1.106.0 by @devin-ai-integration[bot] in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/46628

releases.body:
## Verify Docker Image Signature

All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). Every release is signed with the same key introduced in [commit `0112e53`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0).

**Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):**

A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.0-rc.3
```

**Verify using the release tag (convenience):**

Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules:

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.106.0-rc.3/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.0-rc.3
```

Expected output:

```
The following checks were performed on each of these signatures:
  - The cosign claims were validated
  - The signatures were verified against the specified public key
```

---
## What's Changed
* fix(guardrails): backport #46086 to rc/1.106.0 by @mateo-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/46383
* fix(prometheus): backport #46267 to rc/1.106.0 by @yucheng-berri in https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/46491
